protocol.H: CPU Thai printed-document OCR complements existing parsers.
protocol.T: Proposed 100 lawful held-out pages per printed stratum, same preprocessing, CPU SKU/clock/backend/ABI, threads, batch 1, repeated latency; handwriting and receipt negative controls.
protocol.D: Proposed PASS if lower paired 95% CI >= -2 pp and improved same-task median latency; FAIL contrary evidence, UNCERTAIN otherwise; independent rights, storage, checksum, runtime gates remain.
protocol.C: Domain shift, digit correction false positives, runtime or rights failure.
protocol.U: Sampling, normalization, clock/thermal variance, ABI and dependency bytes; combined uncertainty not estimated.
